During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[jurgoran]] inhabited a canyon on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. A [[Color/Legends|green]]-and yellow-skinned animal with beady black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], the jurgoran was known as the '''Forge Guardian''' by the planet's inhabitants, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Guardian was larger than typical jurgorans, and lived in a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] underneath the rock bridge that spanned the chasm.<ref name="Putting Your New Weapon to Use" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the Guardian was disturbed from its slumber when the [[Hero of Tython|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] opened the [[Vur Tepe|Forge]], an ancient machine used to create [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], above the beast's cave, and the angry beast attacked the young Jedi.<ref name="Putting Your New Weapon to Use" /> The Padawan, who had just [[Battle of the Forge|defeated]] the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]] and rescued Master Din,<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref> was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Guardian with the Jedi's new lightsaber in order to safely return to the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Putting Your New Weapon to Use" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Forge Guardian appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the Jedi Knight-exclusive bonus mission "Putting Your New Weapon to Use." After assembling their lightsaber, the player must either defeat the jurgoran or bypass the enemy by quick-traveling to one of the main planetary locations or teleporting to the nearest medcenter when defeated. The jurgoran has a buff called "Larger" that says it is larger than normal, though its size is the same as other jurgorans in the game.<ref name="Putting Your New Weapon to Use" />
